_comment: Example only. The installer (deploy\jobrunner\install-jobrunner.ps1) copies this to C:\ProgramData\agent-007\jobrunner\jobrunner.json if there is none. The agent user cannot read that folder. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored; an unknown key is an error. There is no setting for the bind address: the job runner listens on 127.0.0.1 only. The HMAC key and the DeepSeek key live in the job runner's own secrets.json (main user only), never in this file.

paths._comment: dataDir defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\agent-007-jobrunner of the user the job runner runs as (journal, audit, logs, secrets.json). templatesDir defaults to <configDir>\templates.

limits._comment: I18: one Claude job and one DeepSeek job at a time, more are queued. dailyCreditCap 0 means no Flow job may run (no default budget, D11): set it when you want Flow jobs. A template's flow.maxCredits is the per-job cap; perTemplateMaxCredits can only lower it.

engines._comment: dsh stays off until the S13.2 live probe proved that dsh asks before running a command; only then set enabled and verified to true, and enable the dsh template(s) one by one.

claude._comment: Optional path: the absolute path of the real claude.exe (never a .cmd or a shell). Without it claude is looked up on the main user's PATH. The version guard (S12.5) holds jobs on a new claude version until the list-runs probe job succeeds once.

hub._comment: hub_start / hub_status run exactly: pwsh -NoProfile -File <dir>\scripts\hub.ps1 start|status <service>. The service ids are a FIXED list: either here, or read from creative-hub's services.json when servicesFile is set. Ports (optional) make hub_status use a TCP probe.

settingsUi._comment: Phase 3 (S18). The settings UI is hosted by the job runner (main user), on 127.0.0.1 only: a non-loopback host or a port equal to ipcPort is refused, and there is no LAN or tunnel mode. Off until you turn it on. Sign in with `node dist\src\jobrunner\main.js settings-link` (a one-time code); `settings-link --revoke` ends every session. 47008 is the default because 47007 is the IPC port. agentUser is only used to name a new allowed folder that has no NTFS grant (the UI never changes permissions).
